abstract.p: We introduce LINGCONV, an interactive toolkit for paraphrase generation enabling finegrained control over 40 specific lexical, syntactic, and discourse linguistic attributes. Users can directly manipulate target attributes using sliders, and with automatic imputation for unspecified attributes, simplifying the control process. Our adaptive Quality Control mechanism employs iterative refinement guided by line search to precisely steer the generation towards target attributes while preserving semantic meaning, overcoming limitations associated with fixed control strengths. Applications of LINGCONV include enhancing text accessibility by adjusting complexity for different literacy levels, enabling personalized communication through style adaptation, providing a valuable tool for linguistics and NLP research, and facilitating second language learning by tailoring text complexity. The system is available at https://mohdelgaar-lingconv.hf. space, with a demo video at https://youtu. be/wRBJEJ6EALQ.
